question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Show
solution:
The correct answer is: **Cover**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Show"** means to display, present, or exhibit something for others to see or understand. (दिखाना)

 
 
• **Example:** He showed the visitors around the museum.
 
 
 
• **"Cover"** refers to hiding, concealing, or placing something over another to prevent it from being seen or exposed. (छुपाना)
 
 
• **Example:** She covered her face with a scarf to protect herself from the cold wind.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Show'** is **'Cover'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Cover**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Exhibit** (प्रदर्शित करना): To publicly display an item or skill for others to see.

 
 
• **Example:** The artist exhibited her paintings at the gallery.
 
 
 
• **Register** (पंजीकृत करना): To record or enroll something formally.
 
 
• **Example:** He registered his name for the upcoming competition.
 
 
 
• **Display** (प्रदर्शन): To present or show something for viewing.
 
 
• **Example:** The shop displayed its latest collection in the showcase.
